summary: One installable XF mod: its manager name, short key, the products and selectors it ships and the presets each selector offers.

name.doc: The mod's name in mod managers; XF-branded by default (XF Eye Artistry for eye makeup).

key.doc: The mod's six-character key, used in archive, namespace and depot names; a fork or clone gets its own.

chosenKey.doc: A key the person chose for a published mod (2–16 of a-z0-9); overrides key in identifiers.

products.doc: Product ID → which features ship in it and its name (the package plan); one product per mod after migration.

selectors.doc: Selector ID → its label and caps, as the selectors design defines them.

selectorPresets.doc: Selector ID → the presets it offers, in menu order.

settings.doc: Export options that aren't per selector (compatibility table, sharing).

from: each collection's latest revision and its package plan
migration.how: A mod node with the collection's UUID (so an installed build is recognised as the same mod) and a new key; a multi-product plan becomes one mod per product; an expression set becomes a mod of its presets.
migration.dryRun: Collections, sets and presets read against planned; a migrated collection builds the same files under the new names (compared with the migration's identity map).
migration.copy: The library is copied beside itself before anything is written.

x-friction.gap: Collection revisions migrate as entries that must keep their saved times.
x-friction.closes: Import entries carrying an original time apart from the append time.
